rows.commentary: 0.1: Saim Ayub floats a drifting delivery back into the pads, but Vaibhav Sooryavanshi carves out space to punch the ball firmly toward cover.
0.2: Saim Ayub attempts a slower, wider variation, but the ball drifts past the tramline and the umpire signals a wide.
0.2: Vaibhav Sooryavanshi turns this delivery toward mid-wicket to rotate the strike with a single.
0.3: Saim Ayub drops this one fractionally short outside off, inviting Abhishek Sharma to back away and cut, but he finds the fielder at backward point perfectly.
0.4: Saim Ayub drifts a flighted delivery onto the middle and leg stump, prompting Abhishek Sharma to retreat and nudge the ball toward square leg for a sharp single.
0.5: Saim Ayub sends down a delivery that Vaibhav Sooryavanshi is unable to put away, resulting in a dot ball.
0.6: Saim Ayub floats one onto middle and leg, prompting Vaibhav Sooryavanshi to drop back and clip the ball through the gap wide of mid-wicket for a single.
1.1: Saad Masood drags this short and wide, but Vaibhav Sooryavanshi’s cut finds the fielder at backward point perfectly.
1.2: Saad Masood drifts one wide and full, but Vaibhav Sooryavanshi drops to a knee and launches a thunderous heave straight back over the bowler’s head for six.
1.3: Saad Masood offers width again and Vaibhav Sooryavanshi punishes it, sending the ball soaring over the deep mid-wicket rope for another maximum.
1.4: Saad Masood rifles this one through quicker and wider of off, allowing Vaibhav Sooryavanshi to chop it into the gap in front of square on the off-side for a single.
1.5: Saad Masood drifts into the slot and Abhishek Sharma punishes the delivery, launching it high and handsome over the long-on boundary for six.
1.6: Saad Masood drifts around the wicket and sends a wayward wrong 'un spinning well outside the tramlines, forcing the umpire to signal a wide to Abhishek Sharma.
1.6: Saad Masood drifts the wrong 'un well wide of the tramlines from round the wicket, but the umpire signals a no-ball for a foot-fault, gifting Abhishek Sharma a free hit.
1.6: Saad Masood to Abhishek Sharma, FOUR, to deep extra cover
2.1: Saim Ayub lures Vaibhav Sooryavanshi into the trap, finding the edge that Usman Khan safely pouches to dismiss the batter for 15.
2.2: Saim Ayub floats one onto middle and leg, allowing Sanju Samson to nudge the ball into the open space wide of mid-wicket for a sharp single.
2.3: Saim Ayub drifts the ball in with the angle, beating Abhishek Sharma on the inside edge as he looks to flick, though the LBW appeal is denied as the ball slides down leg.
2.4: Abhishek Sharma capitalizes on a short delivery from Saim Ayub, rocking back to hammer the pull over wide long-on for six.
2.5: Saim Ayub to Abhishek Sharma, FOUR, to long‑on.
2.6: Saim Ayub drifts one full to Abhishek Sharma, who clears his front leg and hammers it through long-off for four.
3.1: Ahmed Daniyal drops it just outside off, prompting Sanju Samson to stab the ball behind square on the off-side for a single.
3.2: Abhishek Sharma clears the front leg and dispatches Ahmed Daniyal over the long-on boundary for a massive six.
3.3: Ahmed Daniyal angles one into the pads, allowing Abhishek Sharma to clip it deftly behind square for a single.
3.4: Ahmed Daniyal digs it in short and the ball climbs, prompting Sanju Samson to drop his wrists and leave it alone.
3.5: Ahmed Daniyal lures Sanju Samson into the trap, finding the edge for Arafat Minhas to secure the sharp catch.
3.6: Ahmed Daniyal drifts this one well outside the line, forcing the umpire to signal a wide to Shreyas Iyer.
3.6: Ahmed Daniyal drags the length back outside off, forcing Shreyas Iyer to punch off the back foot with a loosened bottom hand directly to cover-point for no run.
4.1: Abhishek Sharma swivels on the short ball from Arafat Minhas and hammers a thunderous pull over deep square leg for six.
4.2: Arafat Minhas darts this one in flatter and quicker, allowing Abhishek Sharma to tuck the ball wide of mid-wicket for a single.
4.3: Arafat Minhas delivers to Shreyas Iyer, who guides the ball toward the cover fielder for a solitary run.
4.4: Abhishek Sharma guides Arafat Minhas into the mid-wicket pocket to rotate the strike with a single.
4.5: Arafat Minhas beats the defensive blade of Shreyas Iyer, who finds no gap for a run.
4.6: Arafat Minhas floats this one up and Shreyas Iyer punches it firmly through the cover region to scamper back for a pair of runs.
5.1: Ahmed Daniyal drops it short and Abhishek Sharma swivels with clinical precision to hammer the pull over mid-wicket for six.
5.2: Ahmed Daniyal to Abhishek Sharma, no run, on a good length and just outside off - driven straight to the fielder at mid-off.
5.3: Ahmed Daniyal loses his radar, spraying a delivery well wide of Abhishek Sharma that races past the keeper for five extras.
5.3: Ahmed Daniyal drifts this fuller delivery sharply down the leg side, leaving Abhishek Sharma to watch it sail past for a wide.
5.3: Ahmed Daniyal hits his mark and Abhishek Sharma finds no way through the field.
5.4: Ahmed Daniyal to Abhishek Sharma, no run
5.5: Ahmed Daniyal denies Abhishek Sharma any room to maneuver, forcing another dot ball.
5.6: Abhishek Sharma stays on the back foot to power a short-of-a-good-length delivery from Ahmed Daniyal over cover for six, bringing up a blistering twenty-ball half-century.
6.1: Abrar Ahmed drifts this one onto middle and leg, allowing Shreyas Iyer to nudge it toward square leg for a comfortable single.
6.2: Coming from round the wicket, Abrar Ahmed sees Abhishek Sharma punch the ball back toward him, where the bowler manages only a glancing touch during a desperate dive.
6.3: Shreyas Iyer finds the gap in front of square on the off-side, stroking Abrar Ahmed's delivery for a sharp single.
6.4: Abrar Ahmed keeps it tight to Abhishek Sharma, who finds no way through to pick up a run.
6.5: Abrar Ahmed beats the outside edge, leaving Abhishek Sharma with nothing to show for his defensive push.
6.6: Abhishek Sharma pivots quickly to nudge Abrar Ahmed square of the wicket for a sharp single.
7.1: Arafat Minhas floats this one just outside off, inviting the drive, and Abhishek Sharma punches it cleanly down to long-off for a comfortable single.
7.2: Arafat Minhas drifts this full delivery down the leg side, catching the leading edge of Shreyas Iyer’s blade as the ball trickles away for a single.
7.3: Abhishek Sharma charges down the pitch, forcing Arafat Minhas to pull his length back as the batter fends it away with bat and pad tucked in tight.
7.4: Abhishek Sharma connects cleanly, launching the ball over long-on for a towering six.
7.5: Arafat Minhas outfoxes Abhishek Sharma with a flighted delivery, drawing the batter out of his crease for Usman Khan to whip off the bails and end a blistering 61-run cameo.
7.6: Arafat Minhas floats one up outside off, inviting Ishan Kishan to chop the ball behind square for a comfortable single.
8.1: Ishan Kishan leans back to guide the Abrar Ahmed delivery through the vacant third man region for a crisp boundary.
8.2: Abrar Ahmed floats this one just outside the off stump and Ishan Kishan meets it with a rock-solid defensive prod.
8.3: Abrar Ahmed offers flight outside the off stump, allowing Ishan Kishan to punch it through the gap at cover-point for a sharp single.
8.4: Abrar Ahmed delivers to Shreyas Iyer who leaves the ball alone to complete a scoreless delivery.
8.5: Abrar Ahmed floats one onto middle stump, inviting Shreyas Iyer forward to dead-bat the delivery straight back down the pitch.
8.6: Shreyas Iyer pounces on a hint of width, rising to meet the bounce and carving a crisp drive through the covers for four.
9.1: Ishan Kishan finds the gap, dispatching the ball from Sufyan Moqim racing away to the deep mid-wicket rope.
9.2: Sufyan Moqim drops this flighted delivery onto middle and leg, allowing Ishan Kishan to nudge it wide of mid-wicket for a sharp single.
9.3: Shreyas Iyer backs away to create room against the tossed-up delivery, but his cut shot finds the fielder at backward point perfectly.
9.4: Sufyan Moqim drops it short and Shreyas Iyer dissects the gap, carving the delivery square for a clinical boundary at deep backward point.
9.5: Sufyan Moqim drops this one fractionally short outside off, allowing Shreyas Iyer to pull it down to long-on for a single.
9.6: Sufyan Moqim tosses this delivery up outside off, and Ishan Kishan deftly tucks it into the gap wide of point to rotate the strike.
10.1: Saad Masood hits the pitch hard, forcing Ishan Kishan to defend solidly back down the track for no run.
10.2: Saad Masood drops it short and wide, allowing Ishan Kishan to clear his front leg and carve a sharp cut through the off-side for four.
10.3: Ishan Kishan nudges this Saad Masood delivery down the ground to pick up a comfortable single at long-off.
10.4: Saad Masood tosses this leg-break up on off, enticing Shreyas Iyer into a drive that drifts and bites away, leaving the batter dangerously off-balance.
10.5: Saad Masood drifts onto the pads, deflecting off Shreyas Iyer's thigh guard to pinch a leg bye.
10.6: Ishan Kishan shoulders arms as Saad Masood hits a probing line to close out the over.
11.1: Sufyan Moqim floats one onto the leg stump, inviting the tuck, but Shreyas Iyer closes the face too early and watches a soft leading edge roll gently back to the bowler.
11.2: Sufyan Moqim attacks the blockhole just outside off, leaving Shreyas Iyer waving an open bat face at thin air.
11.3: Sufyan Moqim drags this short and drifts down the leg side, forcing Shreyas Iyer to rock back for a pull that ultimately finds only the umpire's wide signal.
11.3: Shreyas Iyer punches this delivery from Sufyan Moqim crisply toward the extra cover region to collect a single.
11.4: Sufyan Moqim tosses this one just outside off, inviting the drive as Ishan Kishan utilizes his bottom hand to steer the ball toward long-on for a single.
11.5: Shreyas Iyer pounces on a full toss drifting onto his pads, clipping it wide of mid-wicket to rotate the strike.
11.6: Sufyan Moqim zips a quicker delivery outside off stump as Ishan Kishan shuffles across and fails to connect with the cut.

12.1: Saad Masood to Shreyas Iyer, leg byes, tossed up and spinning into the right-hander – Shreyas Iyer came down the pitch on the drive, closed the face of the bat and the edge rolls towards short third.
12.1: Saad Masood loops this one in to Shreyas Iyer, who advances down the track only to see a thick edge roll away toward short third man for a single.
12.2: Saad Masood drifts it through to Ishan Kishan, who clips the delivery away to rotate the strike.
12.3: Shreyas Iyer punches this Saad Masood delivery down the ground to long-on for an easy single.
12.4: Saad Masood unfurls a deceptive wrong 'un that grips and spins away from the left-handed Ishan Kishan, who misses his aggressive sweep entirely.
12.5: Masood floats this delivery invitingly outside the off stump, allowing Ishan Kishan to simply nudge it back down the pitch.
12.6: Ishan Kishan tucks this delivery away toward mid-wicket to rotate the strike with a single.
13.1: Arafat Minhas finds the perfect length to dismantle Ishan Kishan’s stumps, ending the left-hander's 20-run stay at the crease.
13.2: Arafat Minhas loops one into the surface, drawing Tilak Varma forward to smother the spin with a disciplined defensive stroke.
13.3: Tilak Varma guides this delivery square of the wicket, rotating the strike with a sharp single to deep backward point.
13.4: Arafat Minhas fires this one flat and quick down the leg side, slipping past the reach of Shreyas Iyer for a wide.
13.4: Shreyas Iyer lunges forward to meet the full delivery on middle stump, nudging it cleanly toward mid-on for a single.
13.5: Arafat Minhas drags the length back, allowing Tilak Varma to swivel and pull the ball cleanly toward long-on for a single.
13.6: Arafat Minhas darts this one in flat and short, forcing Shreyas Iyer into a mistimed pull that trickles away to deep square leg for one run.
14.1: Abrar Ahmed lures Shreyas Iyer into the trap, finding the outside edge for Sahibzada Farhan to complete the catch and end the batter's twenty-one run stay.
14.2: Abrar Ahmed baits Shivam Dube with a flighted, teasing delivery that grips and spins sharply away from the outside edge.
14.3: Shivam Dube works the delivery from Abrar Ahmed down the ground to long-on for a comfortable single.
14.4: Abrar Ahmed skids a flatter delivery into the middle stump, forcing Tilak Varma to punch it cleanly down to long-on for a single.
14.5: Abrar Ahmed probes the line and Shivam Dube tucks the ball away toward square leg to rotate the strike.
14.6: Abrar Ahmed drifts one into the pads and Tilak Varma clips it toward mid-on to rotate the strike for a single.
15.1: Saim Ayub serves up a full-toss on the middle stump, but Tilak Varma misses the chance to punish it, nudging the ball instead toward mid-wicket for a single.
15.2: Saim Ayub drifts onto the pads and Shivam Dube neatly tucks the ball away toward square leg for a single.
15.3: Again the line strays onto the pads as Tilak Varma works the delivery off his hip into the square leg region for one.
15.4: Shivam Dube clips this one off his pads and rotates the strike with a single to square leg.
15.5: Saim Ayub drifts this into the pads, allowing Tilak Varma to nudge it neatly toward square leg for a sharp single.
15.6: Saim Ayub fires a flat, rapid delivery into the pads, but Shivam Dube finds only the square leg fielder to deny the single.
16.1: Abrar Ahmed drifts onto the pads and Tilak Varma clips it away with precision, threading the gap to deep square leg for four.
16.2: Abrar Ahmed flights this one onto middle and Tilak Varma strokes it cleanly down to the long-on fielder for a single.
16.3: Abrar Ahmed to Shivam Dube, 1 run, to long‑on
16.4: Abrar Ahmed drifts this short and into the ribs, allowing Tilak Varma to swivel and pull the ball toward the mid-wicket region for a single.
16.5: Abrar Ahmed drags the length back and widens the angle, drawing a desperate, swinging miss from Shivam Dube as the umpire signals a wide.
16.5: Abrar Ahmed drops this short on middle and Shivam Dube capitalizes, camping back to pull the ball between the fielders at backward square leg for four.
16.6: Abrar Ahmed beats the bat of Shivam Dube to finish the over with a dot ball.
17.1: Sufyan Moqim slides this one through, but Tilak Varma finds the middle of the bat and drives it crisply down the ground for four at long-off.
17.2: Sufyan Moqim slides the delivery across the line and Tilak Varma offers no stroke, leaving the keeper to gather cleanly.
17.3: Sufyan Moqim drifts this one up on off stump, allowing Tilak Varma to nudge it crisply toward mid-off for a single.
17.4: Shivam Dube fails to capitalize on a full delivery in the slot, mistiming his strike down the ground to long-on for a solitary run.
17.5: Tilak Varma clears the ropes with authority, dispatching the ball deep over the mid-wicket boundary for six.
17.6: Sufyan Moqim tosses it up and Tilak Varma hammers the delivery straight down the ground for a towering six.
18.1: Saim Ayub tosses it up outside off, but Shivam Dube charges down the pitch to drill a flat six screaming over the long-off boundary.
18.2: Shivam Dube clears the front leg and dispatches Saim Ayub high over long-on for another maximum, pushing the partnership with Tilak Varma to new heights.
18.3: Shivam Dube carves Saim Ayub through the line, sending the ball racing away to the sweeper cover fence for four.
18.4: Saim Ayub fires one in flat and fast, but Shivam Dube only manages to punch it down to the long-on fielder for a single.
18.5: Tilak Varma carves Saim Ayub square of the wicket and finds the boundary ropes with ease.

18.6: Saim Ayub drifts a full delivery down the leg side, allowing Tilak Varma to sweep the ball into the fine leg gap for two runs, capping an expensive over marred by Ayub’s two missed opportunities in the deep.
19.1: Ahmed Daniyal to Shivam Dube, out Caught by Maaz Sadaqat at !! Shivam Dube c Maaz Sadaqat b Ahmed Daniyal 27(15) [4s-2 6s-2]
19.2: Ahmed Daniyal drops this back of a length on middle and Axar Patel nudges it firmly into the mid-wicket region to rotate the strike.
19.3: Ahmed Daniyal drifts onto the pads and Tilak Varma whips it with clinical precision, sending the ball soaring over the fine leg boundary for six.
19.4: Ahmed Daniyal drifts onto the pads and Tilak Varma whips it with clinical precision over backward square leg for a towering six.
19.5: Ahmed Daniyal angles this into the pads, allowing Tilak Varma to flick it toward deep square leg for a sharp pair of runs.
19.6: Ahmed Daniyal delivers, Tilak Varma nudges it toward short third man and scampers through for a single.
0.1: Jasprit Bumrah pushes a sharp, short-of-a-length delivery past the sparred blade of Sahibzada Farhan, but the umpire signals a no-ball, gifting the batter a free-hit.
0.1: Jasprit Bumrah oversteps the crease, gifting a free-hit after Sahibzada Farhan flailed at a sharp, lifting delivery that jagged away.
0.1: Jasprit Bumrah hammers a searing yorker into the blockhole, and Sahibzada Farhan does just enough to jam his bat down and keep it out.
0.2: Jasprit Bumrah probes the line, but Sahibzada Farhan offers no stroke as the ball passes through to the keeper.
0.3: Jasprit Bumrah hits the deck, and Sahibzada Farhan nudges the ball away toward square leg to rotate the strike.
0.4: Jasprit Bumrah hits the channel outside off stump, forcing Maaz Sadaqat to defend firmly into the pitch for no run.

0.5: Jasprit Bumrah digs this one in short at the stumps, forcing Maaz Sadaqat to commit to the hook, where the ball hangs in the air before dropping safely into the deep square leg region for a pair of runs.
0.5: Jasprit Bumrah oversteps the front line, conceding a no ball that Maaz Sadaqat guides toward deep square leg for two runs.
0.5: Jasprit Bumrah to Maaz Sadaqat, FOUR, to deep extra cover.
0.6: Jasprit Bumrah hits the mark as Maaz Sadaqat guides the ball square of the wicket to pick up a pair of runs.

1.1: Axar Patel fires a flat delivery into the middle stump, and Sahibzada Farhan immediately takes the aggressive option, reverse sweeping the ball into the air toward deep backward point for a couple of runs despite failing to find the meat of the bat.
1.2: Axar Patel rounds the wicket and skids a quicker ball into the pads, forcing Sahibzada Farhan to nudge a sharp single into the mid-wicket pocket.
1.3: Axar Patel drifts one down leg and Maaz Sadaqat expertly tickles it away to the fine leg fence for four.
1.4: Axar Patel fires this one flat into the middle stump, and Maaz Sadaqat whips it aerially toward the long-on boundary for a single.
1.5: Axar Patel floats this one up and Sahibzada Farhan sweeps it firmly toward deep mid-wicket to comfortably collect a pair.
1.6: Axar Patel darts this delivery into the pads and Sahibzada Farhan pushes it straight back to the bowler for a dot ball.
2.1: Jasprit Bumrah hits the spot with a length delivery on the leg stump, forcing Maaz Sadaqat to play a watchful defensive shot back down the pitch.
2.2: Maaz Sadaqat dabs a wide back-of-a-length ball toward third man, where a fumble from Dube gifts the batters an opportunistic second run.
2.3: Jasprit Bumrah delivers to Maaz Sadaqat, resulting in no run.
2.4: Jasprit Bumrah hits the channel outside off stump, forcing Maaz Sadaqat to defend firmly into the pitch with no run taken.
2.5: Jasprit Bumrah hits a back-of-a-length line outside off, allowing Maaz Sadaqat to guide the ball down to third man for a single.
2.6: Jasprit Bumrah beats Sahibzada Farhan with a delivery that finds no run.
3.1: Washington Sundar drifts this one wide, allowing Maaz Sadaqat to slice it expertly through the vacant third man region for four.
3.2: Washington Sundar fires it in flat and quick, forcing Maaz Sadaqat to nudge the ball toward wide mid-off for a single.
3.3: Washington Sundar drags the length back, but Sahibzada Farhan’s ambitious swipe across the line catches a thick top edge that sails over the keeper’s head for four.
3.4: Washington Sundar outfoxes Sahibzada Farhan, who chips a simple catch into the waiting hands of Axar Patel to depart for ten.
3.5: Washington Sundar drifts this into the pads, allowing Usman Khan to glance it neatly down to backward square leg for a single.
3.6: Washington Sundar finds the perfect length to beat the outside edge, leaving Maaz Sadaqat searching for contact as the ball zips through to the keeper.
4.1: Axar Patel floats this one too full on middle and Usman Khan drags it across the line, finding the gap at deep mid-wicket for a pair of runs.
4.2: Axar Patel zips this flatter and quicker through the air, inducing a mistimed cut from Usman Khan that travels straight to point.
4.3: Axar Patel slows the pace and extracts turn away from Usman Khan, who rocks back to slap the ball to covers before being sent back on a sharp single attempt.
4.4: Axar Patel delivers a dot ball to Usman Khan.
4.5: Axar Patel floats this one up, drawing the edge from Usman Khan straight into the safe hands of Shivam Dube to claim the breakthrough.
4.6: Axar Patel darts this one in from round the wicket, pinning Hasan Nawaz who fends the ball into the off-side for no run.
5.1: Washington Sundar tosses it up and Maaz Sadaqat guides the delivery toward the gully fielder to pick up a single.
5.2: Washington Sundar keeps this flat and wide, forcing Hasan Nawaz to fend the ball tamely into the off-side.
5.3: Washington Sundar drags the length back slightly, allowing Hasan Nawaz to nudge the delivery toward square leg for a sharp single.
5.4: Washington Sundar zips this one closer to the off-stump, forcing Maaz Sadaqat to guide it firmly toward the point fielder.
5.5: Washington Sundar drags his length back as Maaz Sadaqat charges, inducing a lofted shot to mid-wicket that spills from the fielder’s hands for a hurried single.
5.6: Washington Sundar completes the over with a dot ball to Hasan Nawaz.
6.1: Axar Patel delivers a sharp line to Maaz Sadaqat, who is taken out caught by Washington Sundar.
6.2: Axar Patel floats this one up, but Saim Ayub stays grounded and defends it solidly back to the bowler.
6.3: Axar Patel drops this short, allowing Saim Ayub to rock back and punch a pull shot into the deep mid-wicket region for a single.
6.4: Axar Patel tightens his line to Hasan Nawaz, who finds no way through the infield.
6.5: Axar Patel skids the ball in with the arm, forcing Hasan Nawaz to tuck it square on the leg-side for a single.
6.6: Saim Ayub turns Axar Patel toward the long-on region to comfortably collect a single.
7.1: Ravi Bishnoi slides the delivery across the face of the bat, leaving Saim Ayub searching for an opening but finding nothing.
7.2: Ravi Bishnoi loops it short and away, and Saim Ayub cracks it fiercely square of the wicket for a single.
7.3: Ravi Bishnoi drops the googly around off stump, and Hasan Nawaz calmly nudges it into the vacant mid-wicket pocket.
7.4: Ravi Bishnoi drops it short, and Saim Ayub rocks back instantly to dispatch the pull shot high and clean over deep mid-wicket for six.
7.5: Ravi Bishnoi floats it up, and Saim Ayub gently pushes it down to long-on to comfortably rotate the strike.
7.6: Ravi Bishnoi darts it in short with zero width, forcing Hasan Nawaz to mistime a desperate pull toward mid-wicket before sprinting to clean it up himself.
8.1: Abhishek Sharma floats it short and wide outside off, and Hasan Nawaz flashes a cut straight into the hands of backward point.
8.2: Abhishek Sharma follows up with another probing delivery, kept out solidly by Hasan Nawaz with no run to show for it.
8.3: Abhishek Sharma floats it up and Hasan Nawaz drills it down to long-off, scampering back urgently for the second run.
8.4: Abhishek Sharma loops it up and Hasan Nawaz dispatches it with utter disdain, launching it cleanly over the ropes for a maximum.
8.5: Abhishek Sharma keeps it full and Hasan Nawaz simply nudges this towards mid-wicket to rotate the strike.
8.6: Abhishek Sharma loops this one up on off and middle, and Saim Ayub calmly works it down to long-on to comfortably pick up the single and keep the strike.
9.1: Ravi Bishnoi loops it up around off, and Saim Ayub strokes it away to deep extra cover for a single.
9.2: Ravi Bishnoi serves up a juicy long hop down leg, and Hasan Nawaz brutally punishes it over the rope for six.
9.3: Ravi Bishnoi slides a deceptive wrong 'un past Hasan Nawaz's attempted flick to thud into the pad, safely sliding down leg.
9.4: Ravi Bishnoi tosses one up outside off, and Hasan Nawaz crouches to launch a massive slog sweep over deep mid-wicket for six, eluding Washington's desperate dive near the rope.
9.5: Ravi Bishnoi darts a flatter delivery in, allowing Hasan Nawaz to softly dab it out toward backward point.
9.6: Ravi Bishnoi finishes the over as Hasan Nawaz nudges a single down to long-off.
10.1: Abhishek Sharma drops the ball into the area, allowing Hasan Nawaz to scamper through for a single pushed down towards long-off.
10.2: Abhishek Sharma loops it short and turns it in, Saim Ayub toe-ending the cut toward extra cover before hustling across for a sharp single.
10.3: Abhishek Sharma drifts this one down the leg side, and the umpire stretches his arms wide as Hasan Nawaz lets it pass.
10.3: Abhishek Sharma drops it into the surface, and Hasan Nawaz can only mistime the pull away to deep mid-wicket for a single.
10.4: Abhishek Sharma slides one in low, but Saim Ayub reads it brilliantly to steer it away for four.
10.5: Abhishek Sharma floats it up outside off, and Saim Ayub pounces on the width, going inside out with a sublime lofted drive that races to the boundary for back-to-back fours.
10.6: Saim Ayub nudges this one down to backward square leg for a single, keeping the scoreboard ticking over for this growing partnership with Hasan Nawaz.
11.1: Washington Sundar drifts one in from round the wicket, and Saim Ayub creates room to clip it away crisply to mid-wicket for a single.

11.2: Washington Sundar pushes it flatter into off stump, Hasan Nawaz tucks it away to mid-wicket to scamper back for a frantic second, before a wayward throw and a messy back-up gift them a bonus run.
11.3: Washington Sundar lands one that straightens sharply off the surface, catching the closed face of Saim Ayub's bat as a leading edge trickles harmlessly towards point.
11.4: Washington Sundar drifts this down leg, Hasan Nawaz gets low to sweep backward of square, and Abhishek flings himself to the right to pull off a stunning save and deny the boundary.
11.5: Washington Sundar keeps it tight, sliding this one into Hasan Nawaz who nudges it away toward mid-wicket for a single.
11.6: Washington Sundar pushes it through to Saim Ayub, who plays defensively with a straight bat for no run.
12.1: Ravi Bishnoi floats it drifting into leg, and Hasan Nawaz sits back to knock it sharply to the bowler's right for a dot.
12.2: Ravi Bishnoi begs for the catch as it's floated up outside off, but Hasan Nawaz launches it straight and clear over long-off for a maximum.
12.3: Ravi Bishnoi drops it into the arc, and Hasan Nawaz drills it firmly out towards the sweeper cover fence to comfortably pick up a pair of runs.
12.4: Ravi Bishnoi delivers to Hasan Nawaz, worked away neatly toward backward square leg to hustle back for a sharp two runs.
12.5: Ravi Bishnoi absorbs punishment as Hasan Nawaz launches him over the ropes to bring up a defiant fifty, anchoring Pakistan's chase alongside Ayub after being dropped earlier.
12.6: Ravi Bishnoi pitches it up and Hasan Nawaz dispatches it away to the deep mid-wicket boundary with absolute authority.
13.1: Jasprit Bumrah rolls his fingers over a slower delivery on off, and Saim Ayub reads it well, watchfully defending it back down the pitch.
13.2: Jasprit Bumrah charges in to Saim Ayub, delivering a dot ball.
13.3: Jasprit Bumrah digs this in short at the body, and Saim Ayub swivels to pull, only to mistime it in front of square for a brace.
13.4: Jasprit Bumrah cramps him for room with another short delivery, forcing Saim Ayub into a miscue as he pulls it over mid-wicket for two more.
13.5: Jasprit Bumrah lands it back of a length and angled across, allowing Saim Ayub to guide it down to third man for a single.
13.6: Jasprit Bumrah strays down leg, and Hasan Nawaz stays inside the line to help it along to fine leg for four, extracting nine runs from a rare blemish in the over.
14.1: Shivam Dube delivers the first ball of the over, drawing the false stroke as Saim Ayub skies it into the grateful hands of Washington Sundar to break the partnership.
14.2: Dube bangs it back of a length outside off, and Samad opens the face to steer it down to third man for a single.
14.3: Dube targets that nagging length outside off, and Nawaz chops it sharply towards short third to scamper across.
14.4: Dube steams in again to Samad, but this time there's no run on offer.
14.5: Shivam Dube drops it on a length near the channel, and Abdul Samad guides it crisply towards backward point to rotate the strike.
14.6: Shivam Dube finishes the over by darting one square of the wicket, allowing Hasan Nawaz to scamper through for a single.
15.1: Axar Patel floats it up to Hasan Nawaz, who launches it cleanly over long-on for a maximum.
15.2: Axar Patel floats it slower and sliding in, and Hasan Nawaz leans forward smoothly to ease it down to long-off for a single.
15.3: Axar Patel spots Abdul Samad backing away and follows him sharply, inducing a mistimed pull toward mid-wicket for one.
15.4: Axar Patel darts one in that straightens off a length, beating Hasan Nawaz on the outside edge as he makes room and watches it clear the off-stump.
15.5: Axar Patel delivers to Hasan Nawaz, who works it away sharply square of the wicket for a brisk single.
15.6: Axar Patel darts it sharply down leg, eluding both Abdul Samad and Sanju Samson as the ball races away to the fence for five wides, gifting precious bonus runs to Pakistan.
15.6: Axar Patel tightens his line to Abdul Samad, yielding nothing this time around.
16.1: Shivam Dube steams in, pitching it full, and Hasan Nawaz guides it expertly down to the third man boundary for four.
16.2: Shivam Dube steams in and Hasan Nawaz carves it away, slicing the delivery down to the deep backward point fence for four.
16.3: Shivam Dube pitches it full and close to yorker length as Hasan Nawaz shuffles across to drill it down to long-on for a single.
16.4: Shivam Dube drops it short outside off, and Abdul Samad shuffles across, swiping hard at a cut that catches the outside edge to fly over the inner ring and race away for four.
16.5: Shivam Dube delivers it full and right up there, and Abdul Samad strokes it straight down to long-on for a single.
19.1: Shivam Dube bangs it in short around off, Hasan Nawaz gets inside the line and pulls off the top edge over short fine to start the over with a boundary, leaving twenty-nine needed off five.
19.2: Shivam Dube sprays a slower ball wide outside off, Hasan Nawaz lets it pass to collect the extra with twenty-eight required from five.
19.2: Shivam Dube spears it right into the blockhole, Hasan Nawaz stays deep to jam it into the turf where Samson safely gathers it with his right hand.
19.3: Shivam Dube tosses up a full pitcher around off, Hasan Nawaz drills it straight to long-off and refuses the single.
19.4: Shivam Dube delivers a length ball, Hasan Nawaz stays deep, clears his front leg, and smokes it over deep mid-wicket to move into the nineties.
19.5: Shivam Dube fires in a well-directed short ball that cramps the backing-away Hasan Nawaz, whose miscued pull lands near square leg as he moves to ninety-six.

19.6: Shivam Dube bowls a final short ball on off-stump, Hasan Nawaz gets inside to pull, gloving it behind for Sanju Samson to cling onto the catch and seal India's Asian Games gold by nineteen runs as Nawaz falls for a brilliant ninety-six.
